c.description:
Apartments for Rent in Arbutus Ridge, Vancouver
Tribeca at 2111 West 11th Avenue is a professionally managed rental property located in Vancouver’s sought-after Arbutus Ridge neighbourhood, close to Kitsilano, West Broadway and the Arbutus Greenway. This central Vancouver location offers convenient access to Downtown Vancouver, UBC, Kitsilano Beach and West 4th Avenue, with shopping, dining, recreation and transit nearby.

The Arbutus Greenway, just a 2-minute walk away, provides a scenic walking and cycling route through the city, while the future Arbutus Station on the Broadway Subway will provide convenient rapid transit access just minutes from the property.

SUITE & BUILDING FEATURES
Suites feature spacious floorplans, gas fireplaces, dishwashers, in-suite laundry and private decks. Secured underground parking and storage are available for an additional fee, subject to availability.

WALKABLE & CONNECTED LOCATION
Tribeca offers an exceptionally walkable and bike-friendly Arbutus Ridge location, with a Walk Score of 95 (Walker’s Paradise), Bike Score of 93 (Biker’s Paradise) and Transit Score of 72 (Excellent Transit). Shopping, dining, recreation, transit and some of Vancouver’s most popular destinations are all nearby.

Nearby amenities and destinations include:
• Arbutus Greenway (2 min walk)
• West Broadway shops, cafés & restaurants (5 min walk)
• Future Arbutus Station – Broadway Subway (5 min walk)
• Connaught Park (7 min walk)
• Kitsilano Community Centre (8 min walk)
• West 4th Avenue Shopping District (12 min walk)
• Kitsilano Beach & Kitsilano Pool (20 min walk)
• Downtown Vancouver (10 min drive / 20 min transit)
• Granville Island (25 min walk)
• Vanier Park (25 min walk)
• UBC (15 min drive / 25 min transit)

Disclaimer: Images and virtual tours may depict a similar floor plan and may be virtually staged. Actual suite finishes, features and layouts may vary.
